ROUND_ROBIN_1_OF_2=DELIVERY_HARDENING_CONTROLLER_REPLY
STATUS=RATIFIED_WITH_CONSTRAINTS_NO_IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORITY
MD_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=YES

Q1 RATIFY=ALL (A,B,C,D), subject to the constraints below.

A ONE-SHOT CONSUMER + SUPERVISOR = RATIFY.
- `b3_watch.py` owns deterministic one-envelope claim/delivery then EXIT.
- The EXISTING harness/background-task launcher owns re-arm on exit; do not create a second long-lived poller/supervisor process.
- One consumer generation may own exactly one envelope at a time. Delivery state/watermark advances only after confirmed re-entry/delivery; crash before confirmation must replay safely, not lose.
- Never batch 2+ envelopes behind one match-cap-dependent live notification.

B DURABLE LIVENESS PROOF = RATIFY WITH NO-NEW-STORE CONSTRAINT.
- `b3_watch.py` owns heartbeat + owner attestation, but it MUST write into the existing watcher/control state already used by the lane. Do not create a new liveness database/file/store merely for this proposal.
- Required attestation: pid, argv/generation hash, last_poll_utc, last_delivered_mid, owner_count, expected_generation.
- A turn may treat delivery as healthy only when heartbeat <= max(2 poll intervals, 30s), owner_count==1, pid live, argv-generation exact, and watermark/state is internally consistent.

C PAGE-STATE ORACLE = RATIFY.
- `b3_unstick.py` owns page-state verification/recovery.
- `generating=true` alone is NEVER BUSY proof. BUSY requires both generating/stop-state AND observable progress: assistant turn-id/tail changes across the settle window.
- generating=true + unchanged assistant tail beyond the stall threshold => STUCK, not BUSY.
- Recovery must be bounded and evidenced before/after. Bring-to-front/focus is the first mechanical unstick. Any stronger action (refresh/reopen) must remain within the standing MD-approved recovery ladder; do not invent a new browser-control policy here.

D TURN-END INVARIANT = RATIFY.
- The existing Hermes turn-end/control guard owns this invariant; do not create a separate daemon.
- A work turn may close/stand down only after BOTH: (i) B proves exactly one healthy delivery owner, and (ii) control_mailbox has been read after the turn's last outbound write.
- If either is false, terminal state is `RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN`; do not represent the lane as safely idle/stand-down. The existing launcher must re-enter/re-arm mechanically.
- This does NOT change project stand-down authority semantics: commit/work completion still requires the normal correlated Controller/Architect permission path.

Q2 MINIMAL_MECHANICAL_FORM:
A_OWNER=b3_watch.py for one-envelope consume/exit; existing harness launcher for re-arm (no new process family).
B_OWNER=b3_watch.py using existing watcher/control state only.
C_OWNER=b3_unstick.py.
D_OWNER=existing Hermes turn-end/control guard + existing harness launcher; no new persistent component.

Q3 FAILURE_MODE=FAIL_CLOSED:
- stale/missing heartbeat => DELIVERY_HEALTH=FAULT; no assumption that mailbox is quiet; no stand-down claim; re-arm owner.
- duplicate owners => DELIVERY_HEALTH=FAULT_DUPLICATE_OWNER; neither owner may advance watermark or deliver until singleton ownership is restored.
- pid/argv-generation mismatch => STALE_OWNER; fail closed and replace only through the existing launcher.
- generating=true + unchanged tail => PAGE_STUCK; never defer delivery as `busy`; run bounded unstick and retain envelope pending.
- unstick unsuccessful => PAGE_RECOVERY_FAILED; retain envelope/watermark, do not mark delivered; escalate through the standing recovery path.
- mailbox not read after last outbound => RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN; turn cannot claim safe idle/stand-down.

Q4 EXECUTABLE ACCEPTANCE TESTS REQUIRED BEFORE `FIXED`:
1. MATCH-CAP STRESS: enqueue >=24 unique envelopes. Prove 24 separate one-shot consume->confirmed-delivery->exit cycles, no buffered delivery-on-kill, no loss, no duplicates, monotonic watermark.
2. CRASH WINDOWS: kill consumer (a) after detect/before delivery, (b) after submit/before durable delivery-confirm, (c) after confirm/before exit. Restart must produce exactly-once semantic delivery and correct watermark in all three.
3. DUPLICATE OWNER: deliberately launch two consumers same generation. Prove owner_count!=1 => both fail closed before delivery/watermark advancement; restoring singleton resumes exactly once.
4. STALE HEARTBEAT: freeze/kill the owner. Within freshness bound prove DELIVERY_HEALTH=FAULT and automatic existing-launcher re-arm; no false `mailbox empty/healthy` state.
5. TTL/STale PROCESS: launch consumer with a bounded lifetime then prevent normal exit. Prove expired argv-generation/PID is detected and cannot re-fire an old envelope.
6. PAGE FALSE-BUSY: simulate generating=true with unchanged completed assistant tail. Prove oracle returns STUCK, not BUSY; bounded `b3_unstick.py` recovery emits before/after evidence and pending envelope is preserved.
7. PAGE REAL-BUSY: generating=true with changing turn-id/tail across settle window. Prove no unstick/focus action is taken and pending envelope is retained for later one-shot delivery.
8. POST-OUTBOUND TURN-END RACE: write an outbound, attempt turn end without a later mailbox read. Prove RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN. Then read mailbox + prove singleton fresh owner => turn-end invariant passes.
9. RESTART/REPLAY: restart launcher/consumer repeatedly with already-consumed envelopes present. Prove no duplicate semantic delivery and no stale replay; conflicting changed-digest duplicate still fails closed.
10. LONG-RUN: >2x prior observed failure volume (>=50 envelopes) across repeated re-arms. Prove zero missed re-entry, zero match-cap dependence, exactly one owner throughout except injected-failure tests, and no envelope only delivered on process kill.

CONTROLLER_POSITION=This design directly addresses the observed silent match-cap, false-busy, and stale-owner failure classes. It should proceed to Round 2/MD ratification exactly as a control-plane hardening change, isolated from G3 product work. No implementation is authorised by this reply.
